name: $aveBambi · keep the thread
scope: Goober public picture context into the existing browser-local field log
source_selection: Explicit public catalog ID; corrected reference remains the default of the pre-existing context URL. Unknown/duplicate/other-project selectors reject without image substitution.
trigger: Explicit Keep with this project form submission. Opening any link never appends a note.

writes.existing_notes: Verified before append. Existing compare-head transaction protects against lost concurrent updates.
writes.repeat: Sequential identical saves reuse an existing matching entry instead of appending a duplicate.

source_module.operation: TypeScript-to-JavaScript generation of the fetched existing module; no semantic store changes.

validation.visual_review: Actual desktop/phone browser screenshots inspected through the connected image reader; selected reference/art present and form layout clear.

integration: Gallery viewer offers this local keep action for every currently selected public picture. The native main-app field log reads, reloads and exports these entries with no import or schema migration.
limits: Not a global installed CLI/skill handler
No autonomous care or worker dispatch
This additional project page is not yet cached for offline opening
No user device or existing user records were accessed from the build sandbox
design_lineage: Existing Bambi care/continuation direction and project-doorway work; this is the bounded keep-context slice, not the whole outcome.
